title: Perceptual Spatial Supplement Golden Proof & Handoff
objective: Prove the perceptual-spatial supplement end to end against sealed MSLR core semantics with explicit golden vectors for permission safety, ambiguity/contradiction preservation, frame/identity invariance, accessible multimodal correspondence, deterministic provider-off replay and typed non-authoritative readiness handoff back to the SAA boundary.
acceptance: A complete explicit supplement golden battery passes with no inferred/missing vector status.
MSLR-S01.1 and terminal MSLR-18.1 remain sealed and are proven as the supplement/core basis.
Player/GM audience differences are permission-filtered before cue/correspondence counts and no hidden topology/cardinality leaks.
Exact, ambiguous, partial, contradictory and unknown relations are each proven without guessing hidden topology.
Canonical identity, law fingerprint and local frame semantics remain invariant across schematic/rendered/textual and other presentation variants.
Perceptual evidence round-trip yields typed observation proposals only and grants no traversal, Knowledge truth or canonical mutation authority.
Blocking cue meaning has semantic/text and keyboard-equivalent parity; visual/audio/color/motion never form the sole required channel.
Deterministic replay reproduces the same supplement receipts on Linux and hosted Windows and deterministic comparison passes.
Provider-off operation, optional-AI independence and paid-cloud independence are proven.
The SAA handoff is capability/readiness evidence only; it grants no implementation authority and performs no final Creator integration.
boundaries: The completed MSLR-01..18 family remains sealed; the supplement adds perceptual reification/correspondence capability without mutating prior schemas.
Visibility/Knowledge/Perception owners retain observer knowledge, memory, visibility and evidence authority.
MCS/presentation owners retain drawing/rendering/audio/haptic/text presentation authority; perceptual reification does not make presentation coordinates canonical.
World/Reality/Scene/Location and Transition/Portal/Access retain canonical identity, state and traversal authority.
Perceptual correspondence may encode ambiguity, contradiction, false/suspected observations or authored deception without rewriting true topology.
Permission filtering occurs before perceptual cue sets, counts, explanations, diagnostics, AI context or export.
Every blocking spatial cue has semantic/textual and keyboard-equivalent access; no visual/audio/color/motion-only requirement.
Provider-off operation and optional-AI independence remain blocking requirements.
SAA remains owner-held until MSLR-S02 closeout and a later explicit owner Continue.
next_action: The owner's same explicit instruction authorizes governed start of MSLR-S02 next. SAA remains unauthorized until S02 completes.
